title: Reject zero-occurrence recurring schedules before persistence

evidence: Attempt 2 focused owner/adapter probe passed: 2 files / 10 tests; own-center Admin maps the private rejection to HTTP 400 { error: 'invalid_schedule' }, assigned Teacher retains the private invalid-schedule-occurrences sentinel, and both principals have exact Schedule/Lesson state-before/state-after equality.
Attempt 2 project gates passed: npm run check, npm run build, npm run test (29 files / 116 tests), and git diff --check; no implementation or test files changed during the retry.

Fresh same-Reviewer re-verification approved the adapter-specific contract with no blocking findings: .tasks/TASK-MB-REVIEW-TASKS-PLAN/TASK-MB-REVIEW-TASKS-PLAN-S-TASKS-FT-002-W16-VERIFY-R1-final-report-docs-01.md.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-009 / REQ-004: RED: in fresh isolated state, the same valid ISO date/weekday zero-occurrence command is exercised at the owner boundary as both own-center Admin and assigned Teacher; the unchanged owner persists a zero-Lesson schedule, while the Admin adapter reports schedule_created; capture each principal's row snapshot. GREEN: the owner rejects before writes and each principal's exact Schedule/Lesson state-before/state-after snapshots are identical; the existing Admin adapter maps its rejection to HTTP 400 { error: 'invalid_schedule' }, while the assigned Teacher proves the private owner sentinel invalid-schedule-occurrences. No Teacher HTTP transport is added; valid-occurrence success remains unchanged; artifact: .tasks/TASK-032-T2-FT-002-W16/ and .protocols/TASK-032-T2-FT-002-W16/.
purpose: Ensure Center & Scheduling never persists an empty recurring schedule when a valid date range and weekday selection produce zero actual occurrences for either authorized scheduling principal, while preserving the adapter-specific error boundary.
success_outcome: The owner rejects the same zero-occurrence command atomically for an own-center Admin and an assigned Teacher before Schedule/Lesson mutation with exact state equality; the existing Admin adapter returns 400 invalid_schedule, the Teacher owner boundary retains its private invalid-schedule-occurrences sentinel, no Teacher HTTP transport is added, and valid-occurrence scheduling plus Admin AC-008 behavior remain unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not modify the completed TASK-031 card, protocol, evidence, localStorage implementation, or browser-draft test.
Do not change the completed TASK-026 card, protocol, evidence, authorization ownership, or protected UI behavior.
Do not introduce a new public error envelope, schema migration, dependency, server draft store, or persistence model.
Do not add a Teacher schedule HTTP transport; the assigned Teacher proof stops at the existing authorized owner/domain boundary and private sentinel.
Do not alter valid-occurrence recurrence, lesson identity, add/transfer/cancel behavior, or unrelated validation semantics.

stop_conditions: Stop if the Admin adapter cannot preserve the existing 400 invalid_schedule envelope or if the assigned Teacher owner rejection cannot remain private without adding a Teacher HTTP transport.
Stop if any schedule or lesson row is written before the zero-occurrence decision or if rollback/state equality cannot be demonstrated.
Stop if implementation requires changing AC-008 localStorage behavior, the protected UI, authorization scope, schema, dependencies, or valid-occurrence behavior.

constraints: Center & Scheduling remains the sole owner of Schedule and Lesson persistence; validate the occurrence list before the insert transaction mutates state.
Preserve the existing Admin HTTP 400 invalid_schedule envelope; assigned Teacher has no schedule HTTP adapter in this scope and retains the private owner/domain sentinel invalid-schedule-occurrences.
Keep TASK-031 browser draft retention/cleanup and valid-occurrence schedule creation as unchanged prerequisites and regression checks.
Use the existing inclusive ISO-date recurrence basis and weekday domain 0..6; no recurrence exceptions or schema changes are introduced.
invariants: A zero-occurrence request creates neither a schedules row nor a lessons row and leaves all relevant state unchanged.

Every failed zero-occurrence attempt by either an own-center Admin or an assigned Teacher leaves Schedule/Lesson state unchanged; only the Admin adapter maps to HTTP 400 invalid_schedule, while Teacher remains a private owner/domain rejection.
A request with at least one matching date still creates the planned lessons expected by the existing recurrence tests.
Authorization and center/class scope are checked before the command and remain unchanged.
verification_targets: FT-002-AC-009 server-boundary RED/GREEN: in fresh isolated database state, run the same canonical valid dates and no-match weekday at the existing owner boundary once as an own-center Admin and once as an assigned Teacher; prove the owner rejects before writes and each has exact Schedule/Lesson state-before/state-after equality. Confirm the Admin adapter returns 400 invalid_schedule; confirm the Teacher owner call exposes only invalid-schedule-occurrences and no Teacher HTTP transport is required.

FT-002-AC-009 Admin browser/action supporting probe: submit the zero-occurrence form through the existing Admin schedule action, observe HTTP 400 { error: 'invalid_schedule' } and absence of schedule_created, and confirm the matching TASK-031 draft remains available; this supports AC-008 retention without transferring its ownership.

Regression: retain existing valid recurring schedule for Admin and assigned Teacher, authorization, lesson identity, and exception tests; add only the minimal owner/domain and Admin-adapter no-occurrence assertions needed for AC-009.

Source and transaction review: prove Center & Scheduling computes occurrence dates and rejects the empty result before schedule/lesson inserts, with only the existing Admin route mapping and no Teacher HTTP transport; run npm run check, npm run build, and npm run test.
